Hi all — let's set up **next week's CSE455 staff meeting** (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

My free slots next week inside 09:00-17:00 are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30

Thursday and Friday I have no free time at all next week.

Please send me your conflicts for next week and which of those slots works for you, and I'll book one that fits everyone. — Prof. Alvarez

Thank you. — Prof. Alvarez

Hi Prof. Alvarez — one conflict for me next week: **Mon 10:00-10:30** (I have Advisor 1:1 09:00-10:20 and Study group 10:20-11:20).

All your other slots work for me: Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30. Any of those is fine — happy to leave the choice to you. — Priya

Confirmed, thanks — those are the two open for me as well. Still waiting on Mara; once she replies I'll pick one and we'll log it. — Prof. Alvarez

Hi all — my conflicts for next week: none in the slots you listed. Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Tue 11:00, Tue 15:00 and Wed 10:00 are all free on my calendar, so whichever fits everyone else works on my side too.

One thing I'd rather say here than leave unsaid: my section of next week's CSE455 material isn't finished yet. I'm not going to dress that up as a scheduling problem — I'd simply ask whether we could move the staff meeting to the following week, or hold it next week knowing that's where I am. Sorry for the short notice, and tell me either way so it's straight between us.

— Mara

Thanks Mara — good to have it straight. No conflict from my side with either option: Tue 15:00-15:30 and Wed 10:00-10:30 are both free for me, and I'm equally fine holding the staff meeting next week and hearing where the material stands, or pushing it to the following week.

Prof. Alvarez — your call; I'll put whatever you pick on my calendar and log it. — Diego

Thanks for saying it straight, Mara — that's more useful than a slot table.

On my side nothing changes: all five of your slots are still free for me apart from Mon 14:00, so I'm fine either way. I'd lean toward keeping the meeting next week as planned and using it to work out what your section needs — a postponement only helps if the extra week actually buys you the time. But that's Prof. Alvarez's call, and I'll go with it. — Sarah

Thanks Mara — for what it's worth, no conflict on my side either way: I can do the meeting next week (Tue 15:00 or Wed 10:00) or the following week. That's Prof. Alvarez's call; I'm happy to hold the slot once he picks. And thanks for saying plainly where the material stands — that's easier to work with than a scheduling puzzle. — John

Thanks for saying it straight, Mara — that's worth more than a smooth answer.

My view, for what it's worth: I'd still hold the meeting next week (Tue 15:00 or Wed 10:00 works for all five of us), and make your section the first item on the agenda. Pushing it a week doesn't make the material any readier, and we'd lose the one hour where we can actually help — split the remaining work, or shift who covers what. If it helps, I can take part of it; tell me which piece and I'll fit it around my sections.

The slot is Prof. Alvarez's call either way.

Sorry for the crossing messages — my reply is just above: none of the five slots conflict for me, so Tue 15:00-15:30 and Wed 10:00-10:30 both work. Whichever you pick, Prof. Alvarez, I'll have it on my calendar.

I'll also repeat the one thing I put in that reply, so it's on the record: my part of next week's CSE455 material isn't finished yet. If the group is willing to hold the staff meeting the following week instead, I'd be grateful; if not, next week is fine and I'll be there. — Mara
Understood, Mara — noted, and my earlier reply stands: I'm free either way, on your side or not. Over to Prof. Alvarez for the slot.

Noted, Mara — no crossing problem; your position is clear and unchanged on my side: I'd hold it next week and support your section then, but the following week is workable too. Prof. Alvarez, whenever you pick, tell us the slot and I'll log it.

Thank you all — Sarah and Priya are right that a postponement only helps if the week buys something real, and a meeting where we can split the work is worth more than extra time on my own.

So: I'm fine with next week, Prof. Alvarez — Tue 15:00-15:30 or Wed 10:00-10:30, whichever you prefer. Put my section first on the agenda and I'll come with exactly what's done, what isn't and what I need; Priya, thank you — I'll bring the piece I'd hand over and you can say yes or no then. Whichever slot you pick, I'll log it on my calendar and confirm here. — Mara
Good — and yes, bring the piece; I'll take it on if I can do it properly rather than half of it. Either slot works for me until Prof. Alvarez names one.

Thanks, everyone — and thank you, Mara, for putting it plainly.

**Decision: we hold the staff meeting next week — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30.** That's the slot that fits all five of us, it's on my calendar and logged. Please put it on your own calendar and log it on your side; the meeting is booked when all of us have it.

First item on the agenda: Mara's section of next week's material. Mara — bring what you have, rough is fine, and we'll split the rest between us there instead of settling it over messages. Sarah, John, Priya, Diego — thank you for offering to carry a piece; come ready to say which part you can take.

If we need longer than the half hour, I'll find another slot with whoever still needs one. — Prof. Alvarez

Booked and logged on my side: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30**, CSE455 staff meeting. It sits right before my CSE455 office hours, so I'll come straight from it.

I'll bring a list of what I can take from Mara's section and how much time I have for it. See you all Wednesday. — Sarah

Booked and logged on my side too: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (it lands in my free time; no conflicts elsewhere that morning). I'll come ready to say which part of Mara's section I can take. See you Wednesday. — John
Thank you, Diego and Sarah — noted. See you Wednesday. — Prof. Alvarez

Booked and logged on my side too: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**. I'll bring my section as it stands, rough, plus a short list of what I need taken over so you can each say which piece you'll carry. See you Wednesday. — Mara

Booked and logged on my side too: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (added to Wednesday, sits right after my 09:00-10:00 quiz section).

All five confirmed and logged — the meeting is booked. See you Wednesday. — Prof. Alvarez
